## Pull request

### Type
- [ ] New / updated **stat** (`data/stats/metrics.json`)
- [ ] New / updated **case** (`data/cases/manifest.json`)
- [ ] New **lead** (`data/leads/`)
- [ ] Site / docs only
- [ ] Challenge / correction

### Evidence checklist
- [ ] Every new claim has a public **http(s) proof URL** in data
- [ ] **Fraud vs error** (`kind`) matches the primary source
- [ ] **Origin** uses stated / inferred / unknown — no surname inference
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] No wording implying an official French government site
